title: What to eat at a wedding kenduri when you want to lose weight
intro: Wedding kenduri are hard to avoid. Especially during school holidays, there's an invitation every week. No need to skip and no need to feel guilty. What matters is building your plate wisely. All numbers below are estimated calories for typical dishes at Malaysian kenduri.

best.name: Half a plate of white rice
best.why: If white rice is available, take this. It's lower in calories than nasi minyak and you'll still feel full.

best.name: Ayam masak merah (1 piece, skin removed)
best.why: A good source of protein. Remove the skin and take less gravy to save on fat and sugar.

best.name: Acar buah or acar timun (2 spoons)
best.why: Has vegetables and a sweet-sour taste that makes your plate look full. Take a moderate amount as it has some sugar.

best.name: Dalca sayur (1 small ladle)
best.why: Has vegetables and dhal. Take more of the vegetables, just a little gravy.

best.name: Daging masak hitam (2 small pieces)
best.why: High in protein. Take just 2 pieces and don't flood your rice with gravy.

best.name: Watermelon (2 slices)
best.why: A fresh and light dessert. A good swap for sweet kuih.

careful.name: A full plate of nasi minyak
careful.why: Cooked with ghee and santan. Tasty, but calorie-dense. Take just half a plate.

careful.name: Beef rendang with lots of gravy
careful.why: Santan and kerisik add fat. Take the meat, go easy on the gravy.

careful.name: Air sirap bandung (1 glass)
careful.why: Sugar and condensed milk. One glass is almost the same as a small plate of rice.

careful.name: Bread pudding or pengat (1 bowl)
careful.why: Sweet and creamy. If you want a taste, share with your partner or take half.

careful.name: Fried kuih on the table (3 pieces)
careful.why: Easy to keep eating while chatting. Pick the one you like most, then stop.

hacks: Take your plate and fill half with protein dishes and vegetables first, then add rice.
Ask for just half a plate of nasi minyak. Many people don't finish it anyway, so no need to feel shy.
Keep the gravy separate, don't flood your plate. The dishes are still tasty with less gravy.
Eat slowly and chat with your relatives. The longer you take to eat, the sooner you feel full.
Have a light snack before you go, like a boiled egg or fruit, so you're not too hungry when you arrive.
drink: Cold plain water. If you still want something flavoured, ask for half a glass of sirap and top it up with ice or plain water.

faq.q: I have 3 kenduri in one day. What should I do?
faq.a: Pick one kenduri to eat a full meal. At the others, take a little protein, fruit and plain water. The hosts appreciate you being there more than how much you eat.

faq.q: If I've overeaten at a kenduri, should I skip dinner?
faq.a: No need to skip it completely. A light dinner like soup, vegetables and a little protein is enough. The next day, go back to your usual routine. One day won't ruin your progress.
